items.exampleEn: There is a strong likeness between the two sisters.
The little cat walked boldly up to the big dog.
items.exampleZh: 小貓大膽地走向那隻大狗。

items.exampleEn: I love the sparkle of the stars at night.
items.exampleZh: 我喜歡夜晚星星的閃耀。

items.exampleEn: A phone that you could fold was unheard of twenty years ago.
items.exampleZh: 二十年前，可以摺疊的手機是前所未聞的。
items.glossZh: 前所未聞的；沒被聽到的

items.exampleEn: The old tree has a long, bent branch.
items.exampleZh: 那棵老樹有一根又長又彎的樹枝。
遠處的山丘看起來藍藍的。

items.exampleEn: The road runs westward to the sea.
items.exampleZh: 這條路往西一直通到海邊。

items.exampleEn: The kite became uncontrollable in the strong wind.
items.exampleZh: 風箏在強風中變得無法控制。

items.sentenceEn: He sat with his head bent over his book.

items.audioEn: Walk westward along the river, and you'll find the old bridge.
items.audioZh: 沿著河往西走，就會看到那座舊橋。
items.questionZh: 說話者叫對方往哪個方向走？

items.sentenceEn: The lake had a soft sparkle in the morning sun.
items.sentenceZh: 湖面在晨光中閃著柔和的光。

items.sentenceEn: The crowd became uncontrollable after the band left.
items.sentenceZh: 樂團離開後，人群變得無法控制。

items.stemEn: The ____ sound of a train woke me up.
items.stemZh: 遠方的火車聲把我吵醒了。

items.stemEn: The ____ of the new ring caught everyone's eye.
items.stemZh: 那枚新戒指的光彩吸引了所有人的目光。

items.passageEn: My grandpa was a sailor when he was young. He often tells us about faraway islands. Once, his ship went westward for weeks. During a storm, the wind was so strong that a metal pole on the ship became bent. The other sailors were scared, but the captain boldly led them through the storm and even rescued a small boat. When they finally saw land, everyone cried with uncontrollable joy. A storm like that was unheard of in that part of the sea. On that island, Grandpa met an artist who painted his likeness. That painting still hangs in our living room. Grandpa says his eyes had a special sparkle in those days.
items.passageZh: 我爺爺年輕時是一名水手。他常跟我們講遙遠島嶼的故事。有一次，他的船往西航行了好幾個星期。在一場暴風雨中，風大到船上的一根金屬桿都彎了。其他水手都很害怕，但船長大膽地帶領大家穿越暴風雨，還救了一艘小船。當他們終於看見陸地時，每個人都喜極而泣，停都停不下來。那樣的暴風雨在那片海域是前所未聞的。在那座島上，爺爺遇到一位畫家，替他畫了一幅肖像。那幅畫現在還掛在我們家的客廳。爺爺說，他那時候的眼睛有一種特別的光彩。

questions.questionZh: 暴風雨時船上發生了什麼？
options: 船上的食物全部被浪打濕了
有一名水手掉進了海裡

items.promptZh: 她大膽地把自己的想法告訴了大家。
referenceEn: She boldly told everyone her idea.
She told everyone her idea boldly.
rubricZh: boldly 表示「大膽地」，例如 boldly ask 等說法

items.promptZh: 她常常夢想去遙遠的國家旅行。
referenceEn: She often dreams of traveling to faraway countries.
She often dreams about visiting faraway countries.
rubricZh: 用 faraway 表示「遙遠的」（例如 faraway countries）
